name: Takamiya Nanaka
source: A third-year student who is very carefree and always happens to be in thought. She has a habit of staring at people and has a unique view of the world. She is bad at talking with boys, and [url=/c34422]Daiki[/url] happens to be the only boy whom she likes to talk with.
translation: A third-year student who is very carefree and always happens to be in thought. She has a habit of staring at people and has a unique view of the world. She is bad at talking with boys, and [url=/c34422]Daiki[/url] happens to be the only boy whom she likes to talk with.
